references.title: de.wikipedia: Kopp (Familienname)
references.supports: The surname Kopp may go back to the given name Jakob or be a Low German variant of mnd. kop 'Kopf' or kop(pe) 'Becher', among other origins

references.title: DWDS: Kopp
references.supports: Only the common noun Kopp (Maskulinum), a regional form of Kopf, with no Wortzerlegung; no entry for the surname

notes.rationale: A surname, cited bare and with no Core gender. No dictionary splits it, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050 gives Sources to NOUN, VERB and ADJ only), so it is a bottom word: the Root kopp and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (Kopps) (ADR 0051).
